thread:
emily-sales: Heads-up: BlueWave Health POC kickoff scheduled for Thu 9am PT. Procurement emailed asking for e-sign path, whether we can accept a "pre-PO" to start provisioning, and if DPA edits are ok before signature. Can Legal/Proc/Sec answer quickly?

rafael-ps: Short tech summary: 2-week Dedicated trial, EU data residency preferred, typical traffic ~100 rps, inference latency SLO non-critical for POC. Pricing note: trial uplift ~+25% over hosted, offering $7k trial credit, no commit.

nina-procurement: Customer wants PO in place before any provisioning. They will consider a PO that says "Subject to contract" if Legal confirms that's acceptable. Also requested Net30 terms.

grace-legal: We usually require fully executed MSA before binding Order Form, but allowing a pre-PO reference that is explicitly conditional is acceptable for provisioning. I'll prepare a clean redline for the DPA and a one-line Order Form amendment that clarifies sequencing.

grace-legal: Proposed short clause to add to Order Form: "Execution of the MSA by both parties is a condition precedent to the enforceability of the Order Form; any PO referencing this Order Form is for administrative use only until the MSA is signed." Keep it minimal to avoid back-and-forth.

tom-security: Quick security notes: SOC2 report available (link below), we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated, and we can provide a pen test summary. If they want EU Dedicated, ops lead time is ~72 hours after PO/pre-auth.

tom-security: SOC2: https://redwood-infer-soc2.example/bluewave-report.pdf

emily-sales: Thanks. @grace-legal can you drop the DPA redline here when ready? @nina-procurement if pre-PO language is OK we can ask BlueWave to issue that today and then provision ops.

grace-legal: DPA redline uploaded to thread: ```diff
--- Customer DPA
+++ Redwood DPA redline
@@
- Subprocessors list: Prior written consent required for new subprocessors.
+ Subprocessors list: Redwood will provide notice of new subprocessors and allow Customer 30 days to object; reasonable mitigation measures will be discussed if objected.
```

rafael-ps: Ops question: for EU Dedicated — do we need a signed MSA or is pre-PO enough to create the environment (read-only config)? Need to know before provisioning.

nina-procurement: Ops can spin up non-production capacity on pre-PO reference, production capacity requires signed contract. We'll accept the customer's pre-PO if it contains the PO number and "Subject to contract" language.

emily-sales: BlueWave is multi-entity: billing will come from Redwood EU Ltd, but counterparty signing entity is BlueWave US, different tax entities. Procurement flagged that as potential invoice mismatch. Any blockers?

grace-legal: Not ideal but common. We'll include a payment routing clause: invoice will reference the billing entity and legally-signing counterparty. Also confirm tax docs before first invoice.

tom-security: Also note: HSM-backed signing request — they asked if DocuSign can be routed through our HSM attestation. We do not sign with customer HSM; DocuSign envelope can be set to require KMS-protected keys on our side.

ds-bot: DocuSign envelope created 5123456888 for MSA + DPA + Order Form. Envelope status: sent to first signer. Envelope ID: env_5123456888.

emily-sales: Signer order customer requested: AO (exec) -> Legal -> Finance. BlueWave also asked for a backup sig option for CFO. On our side Redwood signer will be "grace-legal" as primary. Please confirm display names for DocuSign.

grace-legal: I'll sign as "Grace Lawson (Redwood Legal)". Add fallback to "CFO-Redwood" if needed.

nina-procurement: Finance note: Net30 accepted. We'll map PO number to invoice field `PO_REF`. If they issue pre-PO, ops can provision sandbox immediately. Final invoice sent after fully executed MSA.

emily-sales: Action items: 1) @grace-legal finalize/upload DPA redline to DocuSign (in flight). 2) @nina-procurement confirm wording for invoice `PO_REF` and accept pre-PO. 3) @tom-security attach SOC2 + pen test summary (done). 4) @rafael-ps confirm ops lead time for EU Dedicated (ETA 3h). I'll update BlueWave after we have the redline + provisioning plan.

rafael-ps: Ops lead time confirmed: 72 hours after pre-PO for sandbox, 5 business days for production after signed MSA.

emily-sales: BlueWave legal replied — they'll review redline tonight and try to issue pre-PO tomorrow morning. If we get that, ops can start sandbox. If MSA redlines are shallow we should be able to sign next day.

grace-legal: Uploaded final DPA redline and advanced envelope 5123456888 to next signer. Minimal language changes only.

nds-bot: Envelope env_5123456888 updated: status pending customer signatures. Last update ts 5123456910.

emily-sales: Great work team. I'll send BlueWave the one-pager that lists pre-PO template, signer names, Net30, trial credit $7k, and provisioning timelines. Closing here once signed. :rocket:
